hope.speaker: Harold
hope.text: Hope is a good word for a first Sunday. The east window still weeps when it rains. I counted sixteen besides you.

forgiveness.speaker: Harold
forgiveness.text: You were careful. Some of us heard the name anyway. Give the room time before you give it a conclusion.

service.speaker: Harold
service.text: Work, I trust. You talked about the door and the nursery, not a campaign. I will bring my own screwdriver next week.

plain.speaker: Harold
plain.text: They stayed through the hymn. I will take attendance as a fact, not a trophy.
